decision: A conditional worth for one separately admitted original artist sheet; no generation or source execution admitted
owned_decision: Choose or reject a concrete brown ankle-boot vocabulary for later artist source authorship: shaft top, rounded toe, low heel, darker outsole and quiet rear counter seam. The usable improvement is a readable three-view design target, not a footwear asset.

findings.observation: Brown lace-up uppers, darker soles and modest heels are visible in angled views. Trouser hems overlap the shaft tops; a direct rear/counter view is absent.
findings.explanation: An isolated front/profile/rear proposal can make currently unowned shaft and rear-seam choices reviewable without replacing the complete character.

alternatives.A: Declare and inspect one new consistent three-view artist proposal
alternatives.tradeoff: Adds explicit silhouette and rear vocabulary, but generated views may disagree and cannot establish metric correspondence.

alternatives.B: Retain the whole-character boot intention until editable source ownership exists
alternatives.tradeoff: Avoids another raster and preserves ambiguity; small, partially occluded details remain insufficient for a complete footwear design discussion.

witness.source: boot-source-query/ROOT-CLOSE.json lines 3-5 and 26-27; PLAN proposed_visual_contract and proposed_later_stop

findings.observation: The prior literal inquiry closed on a publisher-described green rubber-wellies mismatch; no primary pixels or package were acquired. This proposal instead authors a new brown ankle-boot target.
findings.explanation: The sheet changes a design choice and does not repair that source search. Its value ends at qualitative target selection.

alternatives.A: Keep the new target separate, with explicit newly authored hidden geometry intentions and one candidate only
alternatives.tradeoff: Useful for later authorship, while editable topology, material implementation and foot interfaces remain unowned.

alternatives.B: Defer footwear design and return to another outstanding complete-character goal
alternatives.tradeoff: Avoids illustration effort but supplies no clearer footwear design input; no alternative source hunt follows this decision.

precise_later_stop: Fresh exact prompt/root/critic admission and a finite generation/review deadline precede one built-in candidate. First tool failure, crop, wrong boot class or incoherent ankle/toe/heel/sole/rear vocabulary closes B; no editing, regeneration, alternate query, import or forced constructor. Inspect the entire unchanged output independently.
limits: Orthographic-looking views are qualitative art, not calibrated projections or recovered hidden measurements. No exact dimensions, last, pair/foot interface, topology, PBR, UV, rig, motion, fit or AAA qualification. Original character, accepted/default assets, 13 scoped checklist items and ten broad goals remain unchanged.
